title: Sprint planning checks a goal's step order against the lane rules
goal: Planning a sprint reads each committed item's goal for a step order the lane rules forbid (done or a push to main before a code/<id> merge request merges) and rewrites it or records a gate before start; answers SP-bwlxievv, where ST-cgzd655w's goal put done before sync --push for code items and only the worker's brief caught it
notes: Planning 2026-10-01: a planner's reading of goal text, so the change is skill and backlog.md prose; plan_goal_lane_order is a test in _tools/test_kb_cohesion.py asserting the rule in kb-sprint SKILL.md, kb-backlog SKILL.md and kb/_self/backlog.md (as test_none_rule_texts does).
